data.long_meaning: The name Douglass originated from the Scottish Gaelic 'Dubhglas', which means 'dark stream' or 'black water'. Historically, the name was given to Scottish children born near a dark-colored river or stream.

A child born near such a body of water was believed to be blessed with the strength and vitality of the river.
